program.section_heading: Engine Overhaul and Repair Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate proficiency in technical skills and safety principles required for employment in the engine rebuilding industry.
Demonstrate their ability to assess, evaluate and solve problems common to engine repari in the automotive, industrial and agricultural industries.
Demonstrate a through understanding of the core material of engine repair required for transfer to a four year university or certification in the department programs.
